obstructions_examined.reason_not_proven: The locked dataset and native APS index computation are for the squashed T^{1,1} + Σ⁵ APS sector. They do not include a landscape-wide theorem excluding all other topologies. Ruling those out would require repeating the native index analysis (or a stronger classification theorem) on each candidate — not present in the locked baseline.
Anthropic arguments are forbidden by the analysis rules and are not invoked.
